name: web-artifacts-builder
tagline_zh: 还在为复杂网页手写代码？这个技能用 React+Tailwind+shadcn/ui 搭积木，状态、路由全搞定。
tagline_en: Stop hand-coding complex pages. This skill assembles React, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui like Lego—state, routing, and.
desc_en: Suite of tools for creating elaborate, multi-component claude.ai HTML artifacts using modern frontend web technologies (React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui). Use for complex artifacts requiring state management, routing, or shadcn/ui components - not for simple single-file HTML/JSX artifacts.
why_zh: 同类工具只做静态单页，它专攻需要状态管理和路由的复杂应用，且内置 shadcn/ui 组件库，开箱即用。
why_en: Unlike simple HTML generators, it handles stateful, routed multi-component apps with shadcn/ui prebuilt—no assembly required.
